usefulness.evidence: The useful synthesis maps SNAP household benefits to possible WIC income eligibility while preserving category/assessment requirements. The five-criterion table and household-definition contrast support whether one or both official applications make sense.

sourceAndAssumptions.evidence: Independently inspected USDA SNAP/WIC eligibility/benefits and California WIC documents plus USAGov terminology. Source-to-claim reasoning is reported, not numerical or empirical. The packet correctly avoids arbitrary scores; rejected client/fleet matches have no relevant ModernWallet program-use evidence.

conditionsAndCounterexample.evidence: No WIC-category member changes the next step; qualifying households can apply to both but SNAP does not automatically enroll them. Local documentation/assessment, participant age and household definitions limit the result. No numeric replay is appropriate for these sourced distinctions.

renderedConsistency.evidence: The final complete render contains the supported five-row table, source links and conditional takeaway. The actual mobile table/FAQ/contents behavior and repaired date paragraphs were independently checked and are bound to the final snapshot/review.

localExclusions.evidence: Ordinary reporter policy comparison; no clinical advice, product test, diaper/cash promise, invented professional review or client experience. Saved case-selection rejections preserve ownership and scope.
